fields.label: Input file(s)
fields.help: REQUIRED. Full path(s) to the raw file(s), separated by ; - e.g. D:\raw\scan1.pts;D:\raw\scan2.pts. Accepts .txt .csv .xyz .pts .asc .las .laz and * wildcards. TLS: one file per scan if possible.

fields.label: Role
fields.help: REQUIRED by the CLI (no default there): tls scan block or photogrammetry cloud.

fields.label: Output file name
fields.help: Adapter setting: name of the canonical .laz (or .las) written inside the run folder.

fields.label: Columns (headerless text)
fields.help: Column names in file order for HEADERLESS text files, space-separated, e.g. X Y Z Intensity R G B (use 'skip' to drop a column). Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Rename columns (OLD=NEW)
fields.help: Rename header columns to canonical names, space-separated pairs, e.g. Reflectance=Intensity Sf1=skip.

fields.label: Scanner positions CSV
fields.help: Full path to the TLS scanner positions table: columns name|id, x, y, z (same frame as the TLS).

fields.label: Scan IDs
fields.help: Explicit ScanID per input file, space-separated integers (default 1..N in input order).

fields.label: ScanID offset
fields.help: Added to a ScanID column, e.g. 1 for CloudCompare's 0-based 'Original cloud index'.

fields.label: LAS scale (m)
fields.help: LAS coordinate resolution in m (default 1 mm).

fields.label: CRS
fields.help: CRS to stamp on the output, e.g. EPSG:2950 (needs pyproj). Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Units
fields.help: Coordinate unit when no CRS states it; only 'm' accepted. Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Extra-column dtype
fields.help: Storage type for unrecognised extra columns.

fields.label: Drop unknown columns
fields.help: Drop unrecognised columns instead of keeping them.

fields.label: No raw intensity
fields.help: Do not keep IntensityRaw when the intensity mapping to uint16 is lossy.

fields.label: RGB encoding
fields.help: Force RGB interpretation. 'auto' = flag not passed (CLI decides).

fields.label: Intensity encoding
fields.help: Force intensity interpretation. 'auto' = flag not passed (CLI decides).

fields.label: Dry run
fields.help: Parse everything and report, write nothing (no canonical artifact is registered).
